title: De humani corporis fabrica (Vesalius, 1543)
summary: Andreas Vesalius's De humani corporis fabrica libri septem was published in Basel in 1543 by Joannes Oporinus. Vesalius finished it in July 1542, aged 27, after about two years of work. Columbia University Libraries call it the starting point of modern anatomy.

where.historical_name: Basel, Swiss Confederation (imperial city allied with the Confederation)

importance.justification: A landmark anatomical work described by Columbia University Libraries as the starting point of modern anatomy.
